items.title: Good King Wenceslas
items.sourceLicense: Public Domain as declared by Mutopia and typesetter
items.review: All 53 explicit soprano notes across 17 bars match source MIDI onset, pitch and duration; lower voices excluded, not highest-note extraction.

items.title: Amazing Grace
items.review: Bagpipe ornamentation and 9/8 source meter; not yet clean learner melody.

items.title: Silent Night
items.credit: F. X. Gruber; guitar arrangement Daniel Widyanto
items.review: Guitar score, one MIDI track. Separate melody from accompaniment using source score, not highest-note heuristic alone.

items.title: Gymnopédie No. 1
items.credit: Erik Satie; typeset Evin Robertson; Dover Edition
items.review: Treble may contain harmony as well as melody. Verify full melodic voice and rests from notation.

items.title: Minuet in G major, BWV Anh.114
items.credit: Christian Petzold, historically attributed to J. S. Bach; typeset Allen Garvin
items.review: Melody and bass tracks available. Check source repeats and full form; do not count the current theme study as equivalent.
